Refine this existing hub into a polished esports broadcast package with a stronger, consistent teal-and-orange identity.
Keep the current overall layout, compact top scoreboard and joined bottom player tables. Preserve all match information and keep the gameplay and minimap clear.
Replace the flat grey player panels with layered near-black and charcoal surfaces. Give the left scoreboard section a dark teal gradient and the right section a matching burnt-orange gradient, with both fading toward darker shades near the neutral center. Make their brightness and depth feel balanced.
Improve the typography hierarchy. Keep scores large and prominent, player names bold and condensed, and CS clearly stronger than KDA. Use teal for left-team CS and orange for right-team CS. Keep secondary statistics quieter but comfortably readable.
Carry the team identity into the player tables through subtle team-tinted row backgrounds and narrow accent lines. Use gentle alternating rows and fine separators. Give champion portraits a restrained team-coloured frame and keep them slightly larger than item icons.
Refine the shared “LEC MATCH” heading into a slim, carefully aligned header that connects both tables. Add a little breathing room around text while keeping the rows tightly packed. Coordinate the gradients, accents, borders and typography across the entire overlay.
